Jordan — thanks for sending those over and for the clear ask. We received the packet and W9. A couple of operational notes so your team can align their invoicing immediately:

- PO requirement: each invoice must reference the PO number we issue (PO numbers are assigned per engagement). Invoices without a PO will be routed back to you and delay payment.
- Invoice header: vendor name, remit address, EIN, invoice date, PO#, line-level descriptions matching the SOW, and bank ACH remittance info (if sending via ACH).
- Checkruns: our standard weekly checkrun processes invoices received by EOD Tues for payment the following Friday. We can confirm the first available checkrun once the PO is live.

On terms: our default for new vendors is Net 45 while we complete vendor validation and credit setup. We can expedite the first two invoices to Net 30 internally if Finance approves — that would require a short exception and a signed vendor packet (you already sent that, thank you). Alternatively we offer an accelerated remit program (early-pay) that vendors can opt into — typical discounts vary between 0.5%–2% depending on the window. If you want to propose 2%/10 days, please confirm and we'll route to Finance for a quick approval.

Next steps: 1) confirm whether you want to opt into early-pay (and the discount), or request a Net 30 exception for first two invoices; 2) confirm invoice samples (one test invoice with your preferred header); 3) we'll issue the PO once vendor record is complete.

I'll loop Finance (David) for the credit/exception.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Jordan — thanks for the proposal and for the packet. Quick internal note (pasted below) and our recommended compromise so we can get you live this week:

- Status: vendor packet received and verified. ACH stub matches bank routing. PO issuance pending final vendor ID creation in our AP system.
- Approval: Finance can approve a short-term early-pay pilot as a one-off for new vendors, subject to limits. For QuantumForge we can offer 1% if paid within 10 days for the first two invoices, or Net 30 for the first two invoices if you prefer zero discount. After the pilot period invoices will revert to Net 45 (standard).
- Rationale: 2% is on the high side for our accelerated remit program; 1%/10d is a conservative middle ground that allows us to move quickly while protecting unit economics. We can re-assess after 60 days.

Action items for you:
1) Confirm whether you accept 1%/10d for the first two invoices or prefer Net 30 for those first two.
2) Complete vendor portal signup: https://redwood.company.onboarding/forms/vendor-setup-2026
3) Sign the DocuSign vendor enrollment: https://docusign.com/some/ds-link-quantumforge-setup

Once you confirm we'll issue the PO and list your remit preference on the vendor record.

On a related note — please include the PO# in both the invoice header and the ACH/Check remittance reference. Missing PO is the biggest root cause of processing delays.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
